The '''1982 FA Charity Shield''' was a football match between [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] and [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]] at [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|Wembley]] on 21 August 1982.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lfchistory.net/SeasonArchive/Game/1281|title=Liverpool 1&ndash;0 Tottenham Hotspur|work=LFCHistory.net|access-date=13 June 2011}}</ref>
Liverpool, managed by [[Bob Paisley]] had won the [[1981–82 Football League First Division|1981&ndash;82 Football League]], and Tottenham, managed by [[Keith Burkinshaw]] had won the [[1982 FA Cup Final]] for a consecutive season. In doing so the teams qualified for the season opener which was played the week before the new league [[1982–83 in English football|season]] kicked off.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.statto.com/football/stats/england/division-one-old/1981-1982|title=1981-82 Division One Table Final|work=Statto.com|access-date=13 June 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110816132437/http://www.statto.com/football/stats/england/division-one-old/1981-1982|archive-date=16 August 2011|url-status=live|df=dmy-all}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fa-cupfinals.co.uk/1982.htm |title=1982 FA Cup Final |work=fa-cup finals.co.uk |access-date=13 June 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110717033528/http://www.fa-cupfinals.co.uk/1982.htm |archive-date=17 July 2011 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
[[Ian Rush]] scored the only goal in the thirty-second minute to win the trophy for a ninth time for Liverpool.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.footballsite.co.uk/Statistics/CommunityShield/1982-83CharityShield.htm|title=1982 Charity Shield|work=football site.co.uk|access-date=17 June 2011|archive-date=5 March 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220305154038/http://www.footballsite.co.uk/Statistics/CommunityShield/1982-83CharityShield.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.liverpoolfc.tv/history/timeline/1970-1995/charity-shield-is-won-again|title=Charity Shield is won again|work=Liverpoolfc.tv|access-date=13 June 2011}}</ref>
